Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
User Story: As a signed-in user, I want every data screen to make authenticated calls to YouTube Music's internal API so that I see my personal content (home, library, search, etc.).
Expected Behavior: request(endpoint:body:ttl:) injects a context payload (clientName WEB_REMIX, clientVersion 1.20231204.01.00, hl from SettingsManager.contentLanguage.apiLanguageCode, gl US, Safari/macOS UA, utcOffsetMinutes from local TimeZone) plus the user dict. performRequest resolves the API key, builds the URL https://music.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/{endpoint}?key={apiKey}&prettyPrint=false, POSTs JSON, and attaches auth headers built in buildAuthHeaders: Cookie header for youtube.com, an Authorization SAPISIDHASH computed as '{unixTimestamp}_{SHA1(timestamp+space+SAPISID+space+origin)}', Origin/Referer/X-Origin set to WebKitManager.origin, Content-Type application/json, X-Goog-AuthUser 0. Network I/O runs off the main actor via nonisolated performNetworkRequest; the parsed JSON object is returned on the main actor. URLSession uses 15s request timeout, 30s resource timeout, gzip/deflate/br Accept-Encoding, max 6 connections per host, shared URLCache with useProtocolCachePolicy.
Entry Point: Any data-loading screen (Home, Library, Search, Artist, Playlist, etc.) triggers requests via the client
Test Method: Static audit + unit/VM tests; live-app smoke; UI tests in CI
Notes: buildAuthHeaders also logs total/youtube.com cookie counts for debugging. Origin/Referer come from WebKitManager.origin.

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
User Story: As a user, I want the app to discover the current YouTube Music internal API key automatically so that API calls keep working without me configuring anything.
Expected Behavior: YTMusicAPIKeyProvider.apiKey() returns a cached key if present; otherwise it coalesces concurrent callers onto a single in-flight Task (apiKeyTask) so only one bootstrap fetch runs. fetchAPIKey GETs https://music.youtube.com/ with reloadIgnoringLocalCacheData, a 15s timeout, and the WebKitManager userAgent. Non-2xx responses throw YTMusicError.apiError(code:); network failures are wrapped as YTMusicError.networkError; undecodable bodies throw parseError. extractAPIKey scans the HTML with two regex patterns ( "INNERTUBE_API_KEY":"..." and INNERTUBE_API_KEY="..." ), returning the first non-empty match; if none match it throws parseError('Bootstrap response did not contain an API key'). On success the key is cached for the process lifetime; on failure the in-flight task is cleared so the next call retries.
Entry Point: First API request after launch (performRequest calls apiKeyProvider.apiKey())
Test Method: Static audit + unit/VM tests; live-app smoke; UI tests in CI
Test Result: Pass (post-fix; 926 unit tests green; UI tests in CI)

Notes: Cache is in-memory only (cachedAPIKey); no persistence across launches. Single-flight prevents duplicate bootstrap fetches.

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
User Story: As a user, I want recently fetched screens to load instantly from cache so that revisiting Home/Library/Artist/etc. feels fast and avoids redundant network calls.
Expected Behavior: When a request specifies a non-nil ttl, request() builds a stable cache key (APICache.stableCacheKey: SHA256 over sorted-keys JSON of the full body incl. context, prefixed by endpoint, plus the brandId mixed in via a NUL separator) and returns the cached JSON on a hit (logged as 'Cache hit'). On a miss, it executes the network call and stores the result with the given TTL. Per-endpoint TTLs: home 5 min, library 5 min, search 2 min, playlist 30 min, songMetadata 30 min, artist 1 hour, lyrics 24 hours. APICache.get removes and ignores expired entries. Requests with ttl == nil (history, get_queue all-tracks, search suggestions, mutations, next-endpoint lyrics/radio/song-metadata-step) always hit the network and are never cached.
Entry Point: Automatic on every cached API call
Test Method: Static audit + unit/VM tests; live-app smoke; UI tests in CI
Notes: If body JSON serialization fails, the key falls back to '{endpoint}:serialization_error_{count}' and an error is logged.

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
Feature: Cache LRU eviction and capacity bounds
User Story: As a user, I want the in-memory cache to stay bounded so that browsing many screens does not grow memory without limit.
Expected Behavior: APICache holds at most 50 entries. On set(): at most every 30 seconds it sweeps all expired entries first; then while at/over capacity it evicts the least-recently-used entry (lowest lastAccessed). get() refreshes lastAccessed on a hit for LRU tracking. The cache is pre-allocated to capacity 50 to reduce rehashing. A stats property reports (count, expired) for debugging.
Entry Point: Automatic during cache writes/reads
Test Method: Static audit + unit/VM tests; live-app smoke; UI tests in CI
Notes: Eviction loop is unconditional once count >= maxEntries, independent of the 30s expired-sweep throttle.

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution

This guarantees a brand account and the primary account hash to different cache keys for identical bodies, so a cache hit can never leak cross-account data. The active brandId is logged per request ('primary' vs the id).

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
User Story: As a user on a flaky connection, I want transient failures to be retried automatically so that brief network hiccups don't break loading.
Expected Behavior: request() wraps performRequest in RetryPolicy.default (maxAttempts 3, baseDelay 1s, maxDelay 8s). On a thrown error it retries only if the error is retryable; between attempts it sleeps delay = min(1*2^attempt, 8) seconds (1s then 2s). Non-retryable YTMusicErrors are rethrown immediately without delay. After exhausting attempts the last error is thrown. YTMusicError.isRetryable: networkError true; apiError retryable only when code >= 500 (4xx not retried, nil code retried); playbackError and unknown true; authExpired/notAuthenticated/parseError/invalidInput false.
Entry Point: Automatic, wraps every networked API request
Test Method: Static audit + unit/VM tests; live-app smoke; UI tests in CI

Area: API client, caching, error handling, retry, key resolution
